# Organic Mattress Cleaning

> Mobile, plant-based mattress cleaning service serving Los Angeles and surrounding communities. We use organic, non-toxic formulas — no bleach, no ammonia, no synthetic fragrance — to sanitize, deodorize, and restore mattresses in homes, apartments, and hotels across the LA area. Available 24/7.
